# `clear_calibration`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Clear the stored guiding calibration of the mount, the AO unit, or both.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x74b40 (64-bit guider build) |

With no params both are cleared. Otherwise each child of the params container selects one target (mount, ao or both, case-insensitive) and the corresponding driver clear-calibration call runs; an empty container clears neither and still succeeds. An unknown or non-string child fails with 109, possibly after earlier children were already processed. Which mount or AO subtype is live, and what the driver does for each, is unresolved.

Side effects: Calls the mount and/or AO driver's clear-calibration operation, discarding the active guiding calibration.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"clear_calibration"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Optional list of selectors. Absent params clear both the mount and the AO calibration. A present container is iterated child by child (array elements, or object values: the root type is not checked), each child naming what to clear; an empty container clears neither. A bare scalar selector is not advertised. [READ] |

| 109 | A child of params is not a string or not one of mount, ao, both | `unexpected param` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |

Native error paths below the handler are unresolved.

## Example

Request, both - No params: clear both:

```json
{"id":101,"method":"clear_calibration"}
```

Request, mount-only:

```json
{"id":102,"method":"clear_calibration","params":["mount"]}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"clear_calibration","result":0,"code":0,"id":101}
```

Reply, bad-selector:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"clear_calibration","error":"unexpected param","code":109,"id":103}
```
